info.title: Mantle Place Platform API
info.description:
The Platform API: the /api/v1/ surface that the first-party Mantle Place clients call (the Revit and Unreal plugins today).

This document is for those first-party clients. It carries no stability promise for third parties: the API may change before it is published, and no key, quota or support is offered to outside callers.

Every call may name its client and version in the Mantle-Place-Client header. A client below the minimum version the platform sets for it is answered HTTP 426 with the code client_update_required, so it can show an update prompt instead of an error.

get.summary: Where the Realtime socket is, and the key that opens it
get.description: Lets a client compile in only a mantle.place route. Cacheable for an hour; the values change with a deploy.

200.description: The socket URL and its publishable key.

post.summary: Exchange a sign-in code for a session
post.description: The PKCE code-to-token step of the desktop sign-in. The signed, short-lived code the loopback redirect returned, plus the PKCE verifier, mint an independent session for the curator who signed in.

auth_code.description: The signed authorization code the loopback sign-in returned.

code_verifier.description: The PKCE verifier whose S256 challenge the code binds.

access_token.description: The bearer for the routes that need one.

expires_in.description: The access token lifetime, in seconds from now.

400.description: Refused. Codes: invalid_request (malformed body), invalid_grant (the code or verifier does not verify), mint_failed.

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

post.summary: Renew a session from its refresh token
post.description: Renews a stored session. A client discards its credential only on a 400 or 401 whose code is one of invalid_grant, invalid_refresh_token, refresh_token_not_found, refresh_token_already_used; every other answer means try again later and keep it.

access_token.description: The bearer for the routes that need one.

expires_in.description: The access token lifetime, in seconds from now.

400.description: The session has ended (code: invalid_grant, invalid_refresh_token, refresh_token_not_found, refresh_token_already_used) or the request is malformed (code: invalid_request; keep the credential).

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

503.description: The provider could not be reached. Code: refresh_unavailable. Keep the credential.

get.summary: What an extent costs, before any order exists
get.description: The area, price, pricing-config version, coverage verdict and licence terms of an extent. It runs the price, coverage preflight and licence line checkout uses, so the two cannot disagree. Public: no bearer needed. With a valid bearer the answer also carries the account Credit balance and whether a free-tier slot is open; an invalid bearer is ignored and the public Quote comes back. Nothing is stored: a Quote has no id and no expiry.

schema.description: The extent to quote: west,south,east,north in degrees (WGS 84), the order the brief URL and the curator deep link use. For example -122.4,37.7,-122.39,37.71.

extent.description: The extent that was priced, as asked.

areaKm2.description: Geodesic area in square kilometres, the only input to the price.

priceCents.description: The price in cents of currency. 0 for an extent inside the free tier.

pricingConfigVersion.description: The pricing-config version the price was computed with.

freeEligible.description: The extent is small enough for the free tier, so priceCents is 0.

coverage.description: covered, or degraded when a live elevation probe flaked; a degraded extent can still be ordered. An uncovered extent is refused instead (elevation_unavailable_for_aoi or imagery_unavailable_for_aoi).

line.description: The licence line checkout shows before the Pay button.

url.description: Where the full licensing terms are.

licence.description: The licence terms of the bundle.

creditBalanceCents.description: Only with a valid bearer: the account Credit balance in cents, open holds already taken off.

freeSlotOpen.description: Only with a valid bearer: the account is under the free-bundle cap.

400.description: The extent is malformed. Code: invalid_extent.

422.description: The extent cannot be ordered. Codes: aoi_too_small, aoi_too_large, elevation_unavailable_for_aoi, imagery_unavailable_for_aoi.

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

post.summary: Order the extent the client was quoted, with Credit or a free-tier slot
post.description: Places the order the web curator would place for the same extent: the same rows, Credit hold and build. Pays with Credit (the whole price) or a free-tier slot; never with a card. A refusal the curator can resolve on the web carries handoffUrl, the web curator on this extent. The order records the client the Mantle-Place-Client header names. The bundle reaches the calling host as an export it creates to itself once the bundle is built.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required. A unique key for this order, 16 to 255 characters (a random UUID is a good one). A retry with the same key returns the first order and never orders twice; the same key with a different extent is refused.

extent.description: The extent to order, in degrees (WGS 84): the extent the client was quoted.

expectedPriceCents.description: The priceCents of the Quote the client showed. Any other current price is refused with price_changed.

payment.description: credit pays the whole price from the account Credit balance; free takes a free-tier slot (an extent inside the free tier only). No card payment is taken here.

200.description: The order this Idempotency-Key placed before.

orderId.description: The order id. The bundle arrives through the vault and exports routes.

status.description: The order status: paid when placed; later, its build status.

get.description: The signed-in curator owned bundles, one row per order, with facts from each sidecar manifest. Each row carries the order extent, so a host can hand the web curator the extent of its import.

id.description: The order id; the key of the download and materialize routes.

aoiLabel.description: The name the curator gave the order, else its codename.

layers.description: Null is unknown (a bundle packaged before the sidecar manifest), not absent.

manifestVersion.description: A number before the MPB semver era, a string after it; null is unknown.

sha256.description: The whole bundle archive sha256; null is unknown.

url.description: A presigned GET that needs no bearer token.

deliveryModel.description: How the bundle is delivered; null is unknown, never "complete".

extent.description: The order extent, so a host can hand the web curator the extent of its import. Present on every bundle that carries one.

links.description: Present only when the bundle can start an adjacent order.

post.summary: A fresh download link for one format of a bundle
post.description: Mints a presigned URL for one artifact format, or for the whole archive with format bundle. A host that declares view support sends format bundle with a view naming itself, and gets a link to a view holding only the files its host block points at.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The id of an order the signed-in curator owns.

format.description: An artifact format, or bundle for the whole archive. glb is the deprecated whole-bundle alias and is still accepted. A view needs bundle.

host.description: The key of the host block in the bundle manifest (hosts.<host>).

levels.description: The level wanted of each entry of the host block; the key * is the rest.

url.description: A presigned download URL, valid for 24 hours.

view.description: With a host view: the view block of the view manifest.

sizeBytes.description: With a host view: the size of the view.

manifestSha256.description: With a host view: the sha256 of the manifest member of the view.

403.description: Not the order of the bearer, or not downloadable. Code: forbidden or not_ready.

404.description: No such order or artifact. Code: not_found or not_ready.

410.description: The bundle was refunded or has expired. Code: refunded or expired.

post.summary: Generate more formats for a bundle
post.description: Starts the on-demand build of formats that a bundle does not hold yet. Every materialization is free. At most one runs per bundle at a time.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The id of an order the signed-in curator owns.

200.description: Nothing to build (noop), or the build already running was joined (coalesced).

400.description: Malformed body, or refused (for example code not_queueable).

403.description: Not the order of the bearer. Code: forbidden.

404.description: No such order or bundle. Code: not_found or deleted.

409.description: A build is already running. Code: active_job; carries activeJobId and tokens.

410.description: The free bundle expired. Code: expired.

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

502.description: The build could not be dispatched.

503.description: A data source is unavailable; try again later.

get.summary: What a bundle holds, and what is being built
get.description: The poll target of the materialize route.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: The id of an order the signed-in curator owns.

403.description: Not the order of the bearer. Code: forbidden.

get.summary: The exports waiting for this connection
get.description: The signed-in curator exports that target this connection and are not yet terminal, oldest first. Exports of other curators are never listed.

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

post.summary: Move an export to its next status
post.description: The host reports where an export has got to. The lifecycle reducer decides which moves are allowed.

parameters.name: exportId
parameters.description: The id of an export of the signed-in curator.

403.description: The export targets another connection. Code: wrong_target.

409.description: The lifecycle refuses the move. Code: invalid_transition.

429.description: Rate limited per IP; retryAfterMs says when to try again. Code: rate_limited.

bearerAuth.description: The access token the native sign-in returns (Authorization: Bearer <access_token>). It lasts about an hour; renew it with the refresh route.

PlatformClient.name: Mantle-Place-Client
PlatformClient.description: Names the calling client and its version as <client>/<semver>, for example revit/2.1.0. Clients: web, revit, unreal, autocad. A call without the header, or with one the platform cannot read, is accepted and recorded as an unknown client.

Unauthorized.description: The bearer token is missing, invalid or expired.

ClientUpdateRequired.description: The calling client is below the minimum version the platform serves for it. Code: client_update_required. Show an update prompt, not an error.

Cache-Control.description: no-store: the minimum moves with a deploy.

code.description: A stable, machine-readable code a client branches on. Codes are append-only.

detail.description: Extra context for a person debugging; not stable.

client.description: The client name the request sent.

minimumVersion.description: The lowest version of this client the platform serves.
